title: Navigate reviewed design before code and detect stale intent

steps.action: Add a pinned design relation from an addressable design element to one criterion before any implementation evidence exists.
steps.expected_result: The relation is current and identifies the criterion it addresses.

steps.action: Open the linked requirement from design and the linked design from the requirement.
steps.expected_result: Both surfaces reach the same pinned relation and target.

steps.action: Revise unrelated story context without changing the criterion statement.
steps.expected_result: The criterion relation remains current with carried-forward context reported.

steps.action: Change the criterion statement or linked design content.
steps.expected_result: The relation becomes stale and names the pin that changed.

expected_result: UX and technical design link precisely and bidirectionally to criteria before code exists, and changed intent or design content makes the path stale.
